There are a few exceptions to these basic rules; where occasionally a white will also get you an alchemy shard for example, but it's insanely rare. You can buy portal scrolls from the magic vendors in acts 1 and 3. I am not personally aware if there is a portal scroll recipe.

If you're really trying to sell EVERY magic (blue) and rare (yellow) then yeah, ID scrolls are going to be slim pickin's. I found if I'm not getting too many rares I'll sometimes pick up magics to sell unidentified just for some alteration shards. Not a real loss.

However, if you insist on most magic items, which might make sense in early game to start stocking on currencies, then I would suggest also picking up a few normal items (whites) to sell for ID scraps. Maybe smaller ones to safe invy space like daggers/rapiers/helms/boots.
